briefdescription.para: SUnits - The SUnits for the current graph.
NumNodesSolelyBlocking - This vector contains, for every node in the Queue, the number of nodes that the node is the sole unscheduled predecessor for.

detaileddescription.para: This is used as a tie-breaker heuristic for better mobility.

briefdescription.para: RegPressure - Tracking current reg pressure per register class.
RegLimit - Tracking the number of allocatable registers per register class.

briefdescription.para: InitNumRegDefsLeft - Determine the # of regs defined by this node.
Estimates change in reg pressure from this SU.

detaileddescription.para: It is achieved by trivial tracking of defined and used vregs in dependent instructions. The RawPressure flag makes this function to ignore existing reg file sizes, and report raw def/use balance.

briefdescription.para: Main access point - returns next instructions to be placed in scheduling sequence.
Check if scheduling of this SU is possible in the current packet.
adjustPriorityOfUnscheduledPreds - One of the predecessors of SU was just scheduled.

detaileddescription.para: If SU is not itself available, then there is at least one predecessor node that has not been scheduled yet. If SU has exactly ONE unscheduled predecessor, we want to increase its priority: it getting scheduled will make this node available, so it is better than some other node of the same priority that will not make a node available.

briefdescription.para: getSingleUnscheduledPred - If there is exactly one unscheduled predecessor of SU, return it, otherwise return null.
